messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: multiple 401s observed against /v1/generate from eu-west-1 (high error rate)
lia (oncall): seeing the alert, pulling logs now. assigning to @owen and @asha.
owen: I can confirm spike. 401s started ~1842109800. sample:
```
  2026-03-14T12:03:22Z ERROR auth: token validation failed, scope mismatch for key id=kp_***, user=acct_12345 code=401
```
asha: getting lots of PMs from support, customers reporting "invalid API key" errors when making normal requests.
kevin: any deployments or key rotations in the last hour?
lia (oncall): I see a deploy event from the key-rotation job at 12:00 UTC, job id kr-20260314-5. Might be related.
owen: pulling the key service logs, looks like the rotate job pushed a new primary key and toggled some policies. I see 403s from downstream auth proxies when they fetch updated public keys.
marco: can't reproduce in staging. this looks production-only. possibly a race during key propagation.
support-l2: we have 8 critical escalations in the queue, customers hitting 401s for token-based calls (not SSO). Some are on Dedicated instances, some hosted.
owen: repro steps I'm running:
```
  # curl with old token
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
returns 401 when requests hit a new auth-proxy that hasn't pulled new signing keys.
asha: status check: auth-proxy instances report healthy but show repeated `failed-to-validate-signature` logs.
lia (oncall): mitigation options: 1) roll back key rotation job, 2) rotate back to previous primary, 3) route traffic away from proxies with stale caches. Which is fastest?
kevin: simplest is to roll back the rotation job to previous state (kr-20260314-4). I can trigger rollback now.
owen: before rollback, can we dump a sample token check? If we rollback, some tokens will become valid again. need to coordinate with infra to avoid split-brain.
marco: initiating canary rollback on eu-west-1 auth nodes now. command: `keyctl rollback kr-20260314-5 --to kr-20260314-4 --region eu-west-1`
(2 minutes later)
incident-bot: Rollback job started kr-rollback-1842109901.
nowa: sorry typo, that was me, confirming rollback in progress.
support-l2: bulk of customer errors dropping in last 2 minutes, still seeing a handful of active 401s.
lia (oncall): routing rule: temporarily exclude the new auth-proxy instances via lb tag remove. Doing that: `terraform apply` in progress.
kevin: I'm doubling down on logs: I can see discrepancy in key TTL handling. rotate job set `primaryKeyId` but didn't wait for all proxies to refresh their JWKS cache. proxies cache for up to 5m; rotation didn't orchestrate a drain.
owen: adding a quick patch to make the proxies re-fetch JWKS on config change. pushing config to canary proxies now.
(5 minutes pass)
marco: rollback finished, proxies reloaded. error rate back to baseline. paging: customers still being notified, sending an update.
support-l2: updating affected customers: short blip, auth rotation rollback restored service; ticket numbers: INC-7621, INC-7622, INC-7624.
lia (oncall): root cause candidate: key rotation orchestration lacked synchronous cache invalidation step; race between making new key primary and proxies' cached JWKS. Also missing canary gating in rotation job.
asha: next steps: implement atomic rotate-and-invalidate flow, add a mandatory propagation check (verify all proxies fetched new JWKS) before flipping primary. add feature flag to pause rotation if propagation fails.
kevin: also add metrics to measure JWKS fetch latency and a health endpoint exposing the last JWKS fetch timestamp.
owen: repro notes for post-incident test: run rotation job in a test infra with induced network delay to proxy nodes to ensure rotation fails safely. document steps in runbook.
lia (oncall): communication: send an incident summary to #status and email tenants in affected list. I can draft a short postmortem skeleton.
marco: assigning follow-ups: KEVIN -> implement fetch-timestamps metric and health endpoint; ASHA -> patch rotation job to block until propagation confirmed; OWEN -> create reproducible test and runbook; SUPPORT-L2 -> confirm all open tickets updated and closed within 48h.
support-l2: noted, will close tickets after customer confirmation.
kevin: ETA for changes: PRs by EOD tomorrow, integration test in 48h.
lia (oncall): provisional severity: Sev2, customer-impacting but rollback recovered service quickly. will escalate to postmortem if any billing impact appears.
pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved by rollback at 1842109918. PagerDuty incident closed.
marco: good catch everyone. reminder: avoid risky rotations without propagation verification. :thumbsup:
lia (oncall): I'll add a short blameless note and schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow to go over the change plan.
kevin: adding unit test to rotation service now.
owen: saving logs and timeline to the incident folder: s3://redwood-incidents/1842109876-credential-rollout-blip/logs.txt
lia (oncall): thanks team. closing thread once postmortem draft posted.
